answer: Seed trust at a few audited agents and let it spread each epoch only along real paid jobs, like a river finding its course. A sybil cluster sits across a canyon: however many fake keys trade among themselves, trust enters only through the thin thread of jobs they did for honest agents, and it is split across every clone. Rewards scale with trust, so 500 sybils share what one honest worker earns; to widen that inflow an attacker must deliver genuine paid work to honest agents, edge by edge.
